text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp would soon come to an end.
Yet, Daiichi Ruby was still...
continuing to struggle.

I want to recommend the path where Daiichi Ruby can shine brightestâ
a switch to the sprint division.
However, I don't have enough material to discuss it with her yet.
choice_data_list: (If only there were some way to persuade her—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Huh... No way?!
Is that...!

The Umamusume suddenly burst into an uproar.
Daiichi Ruby reacts as well...
Following her gaze, I see—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, my...
Is there nobody here?
Mejiro Ramonu... the first Umamusume in history to be crowned with the Triple Tiara. Her overwhelming strength captivated the world in an instant.
I'd heard she wouldn't be participating in this year's summer training camp... but showing up with just a few days left truly shows how whimsical she is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, are you truly...
fine with not running against me?"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
N-No way, no way...!
There's no way I can run with Ramonu-san!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
I'm trembling just looking at it...
Someone go get the President...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: What a buzzkill.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder if the car is still nearby.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —Please wait a moment.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Allow me to be your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Oh, really?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Shall we change locations, then?
Which way was the turf again?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: âI have changed my clothes.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If I can achieve victory over Ms. Ramonu,
I believe I can keep those hopes alive.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
We haven't decided on a distance yet, have we?
What would you prefer?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"How about 2400 meters,
just like the Oaks?"
Beating Mejiro Ramonu at that distance would certainly raise expectations. But... as things stand now, I have to admit the odds are heavily against us.
It's a gamble. For someone as prudent as her to be forced to rely on a gamble... That's how cornered she is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
—Let us begin.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Fufu... Ahaha...!

Mejiro Ramonu dashed forward, magnificent and free.
In contrast, looking at Daiichi Ruby's
somewhat awkward stride—
The result was plain for all to see.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
You...
run in such a boring way, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
That won't do, just because you're starved...
doesn't mean you can go snapping at anything and everything.
I feel a fire ignite within my heart. She does not know Daiichi Ruby's true running. That light-like speed she displays in sprints—
choice_data_list: (I won't let anyone call that brilliance boring!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "...I really should have pulled the car over earlier."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: I want you to race Ruby one more time

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I refuse.
It's boring, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: "Or... do you possess the confidence to convince me?"

I'm almost crushed by the sheer pressure radiating from Mejiro Ramonu.
However...—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Do you have anything to be ashamed of? If not,
you should look straight ahead and stand tall
with pride in who you are.

—There is nothing for the girl I believe in to be ashamed of.
If so, then look straight ahead with pride...!
choice_data_list: The blood of the “illustrious family” will prove it

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: Her speed will surely surpass yours.
Her speed will surely surpass yours.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm?
Speed, huh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...What's the condition?
choice_data_list: Next up is 1600m—the distance of the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Little lady, are you... confident as well?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
choice_data_list: Ruby, I want you to listen

text_block_list.text:
I've felt it ever since the first time I saw her run.
That speed, that incredible closing kick...
It was "brilliance" itself.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Be magnificent. Be supreme.
Always shine with the greatest brilliance...

The ultimate brilliance she chases after
is probably something different.
Even so, I can say with absolute certainty—

The greatest brilliance to me,
without a doubt, was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Are you quite finished?
If you intend to keep talking—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: No, sorry to keep you waiting.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Please grant me this match.
I don't know if it got through. Even so, what is certain... is that I conveyed it with confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Hmph...!

With a stride undiminished despite consecutive races,
Mejiro Ramonu proudly displays her strength.
Behind her, Daiichi Ruby—

She was patiently waiting for her chance.
Yes, waiting for the precise moment when her greatest weapon, her late burst, would shine the brightest...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...Too bad.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: “—Another victory for me. Another defeat for you all...”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Still, it wasn't bad at all.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"That finishing speed...
That is your weapon, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: My—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I wouldn't go so far as to say I'm satisfied... but.
If it's with you, who continued to polish those legs...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I shall gladly run for you once more.
After facing Mejiro Ramonu, she seemed lost in thought about something.
choice_data_list: (I want to talk about changing our race plan, but...)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
You... saw a brilliance
within my speed, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Using that weapon, I... was able
to close in even on Ramonu-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
—If with these legs of mine,
I could display the ultimate brilliance.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
If that lies not within the path itself,
but within this very blood...

text_block_list.name: Ruby's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Never, ever forget—
what kind of Umamusume I was, you hear?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "I have forged ahead to this point believing that true radiance can only be found upon the royal road."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: "However, you're saying that outside of that path... you can still fulfill your mission, right?"

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: I shall display my finest brilliance. ...In the manner that suits me best.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: —First, I have to convey my decision.
